description: Step 8 xbrlrag-cross-section (docs/design/scenario_set_and_ablation_design.md §5.1, §9): XbrlRag company legs for every covered book name per theme. Calibration only where the theme fact resolves OK in XbrlRag at FY2025; baseline = mean exposure of the scenario's calibrated names, so the facts spread the loss across names rather than raise overall severity; scale clamped to [0.5, 1.5]. Other legs are grounding-only (reason in _calibration_note). Upsert: rate_capital and keyman_nvda are unchanged.

ai_deflation.narrative: AI deflation, multi-month: the AI thesis unwinds over months across the whole chain -- the 2022 peak-to-trough replay (NVDA -66%, SMH -44%, XLK -31%), applied as one instantaneous shock to today's book (no option expiries, carry or rebalancing over the window).
ai_deflation.trigger: Hyperscaler capex guidance cut / AI demand digestion; EIA-FERC power-demand signal

macro.synthesis_question: If AI data-center capex and hyperscaler guidance roll over and the AI trade unwinds over several months (as from the late-2021 peak to the October 2022 trough), a risk-off de-rating in which IG and HY credit spreads widen and MOVE and VIX rise, quantify the shocks over the scenario horizon to IG and HY credit spreads, MOVE, VIX and the UST 2/5/10/30 curve, with citations. (Equity legs are set separately.)
